cards.name: World Elite

lounge.text: 14 visits a year via Mastercard Travel Pass (activate with a USD 1 spend)

insurance.text: Travel insurance, rental car damage waiver

cards.notes: Earns 0.735 Al Masraf Points per USD (0.2/AED); aggregator says about 1% cashback-equivalent, so point_value_aed 0.05 gives 1%. Joining fee and annual fee both quoted (up to this amount). No cap. 14 visits a year lounge. Bank page (World Elite) confirms 0.735 points per USD local and international, described as 1% cashback equivalent, no cap; fees point to a schedule of charges I could not read, so fees stay aggregator.
